# Grant Riches

## Favourite Sport
My favourite football. I love football because it's fun to play and a great way to keep fit. I also like how it brings families together to watch the sport. Going to a football match with my children is really special to me.

## Favourite Food
My favourite food? That's a tough one! My favourite cuisine is Turkish. Lot's of grilled meat, rice, fresh vegetables and bread. I couldn't pick a single dish as my avourite but I love that Turkish food uses good quality, fresh ingredients, cooked using basic but effective techniques.

## Favourite Music
Again, music is a tough category to have to identify a favourite. The band that I am listening to the most at the minute are called The K's. I saw them live when they were supporting another band I like at a gig. I was instantly drawn in by their sound and I have seen them live many times since. In 2024 my children ended up on stage with them at a festival in Bridlington.

## Interesting Fact
One interesing fact about me is that I can play a few songs on the piano. I was driving along one day and spotted a children's keyboard that had been thrown out. I took the keyboard home and taught myself how to play some songs. I can't read music but the songs I can play sound pretty good. Playing piano is a great way relax when I need to take a break from working beacuse it requires my absolute attention.
